raw.query:
WITH current_dim AS (
  SELECT run_id, source_path, superseded_by
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = TRUE
    AND run_id IN ('measured:vllm_h100_trace', 'measured:vllm_per_request')
), clock_evidence AS (
  SELECT source_path, experiment, clocks_locked, sm_clock_mhz, is_valid
  FROM provenance.collector_bench_run
  WHERE source_path IN (
    '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/burst_anchor_all.json',
    '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_vit.json'
  )
), validation_evidence AS (
  SELECT run_id, COUNT(*) AS metric_rows, ARRAY_AGG(metric ORDER BY metric) AS metrics
  FROM provenance.vllm_sim_validation
  WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM current_dim)
  GROUP BY run_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(c) ORDER BY c.source_path) FROM clock_evidence c) AS clock_rows,
  (SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(d) ORDER BY d.run_id) FROM current_dim d) AS current_runs,
  (SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v) ORDER BY v.run_id) FROM validation_evidence v) AS validation_rows
